items.title: An open map with irreducible target and irreducible fibres over a dense set of points has irreducible source
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is a topological criterion for irreducibility of the source of an open map (author lemma at source lines 1331-1340, label lemma-irreducible-on-top), under the hypotheses that the target is irreducible and that the fibres over a dense set of points are irreducible. The proof (source lines 1342-1353) uses all three hypotheses in a genuine way: openness pushes the two pieces of a presumed separation into the target, irreducibility of the target picks a point of the dense set where one piece misses, and irreducibility of the fibre there contradicts the existence of the separation (proof lines 1345-1352). The lemma is used in this chapter and in the Stacks treatment of morphisms to propagate irreducibility. H2.
